visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man with blonde hair and numerous tattoos is sitting on a black weight bench inside a modern gym, looking down at his smartphone. Another man wearing a navy blue hoodie with a yellow 'W' logo on the chest and khaki shorts walks into the frame from the left and stands next to the bench. (2) The man in the hoodie suddenly leans over and forcefully grabs the phone from the seated man's hands while shouting. The seated man looks up with a surprised and slightly annoyed facial expression. (3) The man in the hoodie holds the smartphone up towards the seated man, pointing at the screen and gesturing aggressively with his free hand. They are surrounded by racks of dumbbells and fitness equipment under bright indoor lighting. (4) The scene cuts to a different area of the gym with green turf flooring. A man with curly hair wearing a black t-shirt and grey pants performs exaggerated, ninja-like rolls and martial arts movements while holding a smartphone. (5) The camera returns to the original two men. The man in the hoodie is shouting loudly and leaning very close to the seated man's face, who appears stunned. (6) Both men are now looking closely at the smartphone screen held by the coach. The seated man's expression shifts from confusion to an intense, wide-eyed focus. (7) The seated man begins to speak intensely, making a fist and looking directly at the coach. His posture is rigid, and he appears possessed by what he is seeing on the screen. (8) The man in the hoodie rests his head on the seated man's shoulder, feigning a crying expression while clutching his chest. The seated man continues to look forward with a blank, obsessed stare.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a standard conversational volume as a man greets his coach. The background has a faint indoor hum. (2) A sudden burst of shouting occurs as the coach yells about the student being on his phone. A low, tension-filled synthesizer drone begins as background music. (3) The coach's voice becomes very loud and high-pitched, expressing mock horror about a game. The speech rate is rapid. (4) Sharp 'whoosh' and 'impact' sound effects are heard during a cutaway, paired with shouting that mimics martial arts anime tropes. (5) The coach's voice strains and wavers as he continues to shout in a comedic, desperate tone. (6) The seated student's voice shifts into a low-pitched, intense, and hypnotic tone as he recites game terminology. A shimmering digital synthesizer effect highlights his 'obsession.' (7) The audio concludes with the coach making loud, exaggerated wailing and sobbing noises while the student continues his intense, low-voiced monologue.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Warning -> Evidence -> Irony -> Humorous Resolution
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous promotional skit designed to showcase the addictive nature and new features of the mobile game 'Monster Hunter Now'. By framing the game as a distraction that even a dedicated athlete cannot resist, it uses comedy and relatable gym scenarios to engage the audience and highlight specific in-game updates like new armor sets and skills.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The characters explicitly mention the game title 'Monster Hunter Now' multiple times and describe specific gameplay features like 'Glavenus armor' and 'Group Hunt' skills.
